description: This file defines a route component for displaying the user's quiz results in a Remix application. It includes loader functions for fetching results data, and a React component to render the results list or a message if no results are available.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Defines the meta tags for the route, setting the page title.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Asynchronous function that fetches the current user's results, redirecting to login if user is not authenticated.

methods.name: ResultsIndexRoute
methods.description: React component that renders the user's quiz results, including links to detailed results pages.
